mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND status = 'ACTIVE'::plan_status_enum LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE plan_id = #{planId}::uuid ORDER BY day_number

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sequence, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe, p.created_at AS prescription_created_at, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url FROM prescriptions p JOIN workouts w ON w.id = p.workout_id JOIN exercises e ON e.id = p.exercise_id WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId}::uuid ORDER BY w.day_number, p.sequence
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND plan_id = #{planId}::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sequence, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe, p.created_at AS prescription_created_at, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url FROM prescriptions p JOIN exercises e ON e.id = p.exercise_id WHERE p.workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid ORDER BY p.sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE workouts SET completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND completed_at IS NULL
UPDATE plans SET status = 'SUPERSEDED'::plan_status_enum, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND status = 'ACTIVE'::plan_status_enum AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans ( id, user_id, profile_snapshot, status, start_date, end_date, parent_plan_id, version ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{userId}::uuid, #{profileSnapshot, typeHandler=com.fitness.config.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{status}::plan_status_enum, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{parentPlanId}::uuid, #{version} )
INSERT INTO workouts (id, plan_id, day_number, focus) VALUES (#{id}::uuid, #{planId}::uuid, #{dayNumber}, #{focus}::training_day_focus_enum)

INSERT INTO prescriptions ( id, workout_id, exercise_id, sequence, sets, reps, load, load_type, rpe ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{workoutId}::uuid, #{exerciseId}, #{sequence}, #{sets}, #{reps}, #{load}, #{loadType}::load_type_enum, #{rpe} )
